title: Session identity
summary: Authenticated function calls carry the actor session through nested Conduct task-status claim checks. Exact task claims or parent authority authorize the write; payload identity and the server process session do not. Retained local calls use canonical ambient identity. Authorized session rosters, ended history, machine usage and boards include owned or org-readable sessions outside any project. An authenticated all-scope public board admits an actor with no readable projects only when it can operate an outside-project session; project data stays hidden. Configured session and timeline scopes cannot expand readable project authority, including numeric selections. Explicit numeric and slug session project refs resolve within caller visibility; unavailable refs return normal not_found or empty mode-specific results. Explicit project filters exclude org sessions. Local boards use the universe-proven operating actor and refuse an unavailable identity. These are source behaviors; deployed proof is pending.
